observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 151.» (L9) and «p. 152.» (L35) in the left margin.
body L1: the fraction is printed with the denominator 5×10 in small figures: one fifth of a tenth (of a minute), as note 1 explains.
body L8: the letter of the reference (c) is bold italic.

notes_left L6: the prime after «50» is printed short, as a point, and the full stop after the last fraction is printed raised.
